Git integration is deliberately DISCONNECTED (2026-07-30) — pushes to main no longer trigger a build at all. An ignoreCommand git-diff was tried first, but Vercel's build checkout has no HEAD^ (shallow clone), so the diff command itself errored on every push and Vercel treated that as 'proceed to build' — the opposite of the intent, and the actual cause of the repeated failed-deployment notifications. Disconnecting is simpler and cannot fail the same way. When api/og.mjs actually changes: `vercel --prod --yes --scope nuroctane-projects` from this repo root.
